Luis,
As we changed over to Salted Caramel on the FFS this evening, I reviewed the inventory levels and immediately noticed that WIP pallets are once again not being sent in FIFO order.
There are multiple older single-pallet lots, specifically 61L and 62G, that should have been consumed before newer inventory. While we did consume all of the 62P inventory and are now changing over to 62R, there are currently 30 pallets of 62R in NetSuite and only 20 pallets were sent. We started shift with only 6, then 14 pallets arrived.
In addition, 5 pallets of 63B were sent. This not only breaks FIFO, but also leaves available 62R inventory unconsumed and creates an unnecessary lot changes. Furthermore, when the 63B WIP was sent, the 77 pallets of 63A, which should be consumed before 63B under FIFO, were completely bypassed.
Can you please connect with the L3/LN teams and make arrangements to ensure the appropriate WIP is moved and consumed in FIFO order going forward?
Thank you.
Alan, Alex, Jeffrey, Brandon, Mathew, Gustavo, Chad Stone
